verdict.rationale: Calendly Workflows automate pre- and post-meeting emails and texts to invitees, hosts and teammates, and one-click reminders go to people who haven't booked yet. Routing automatically matches leads to owners, and the Callie AI assistant coordinates scheduling over email on the user's behalf, so background automation is clearly delivered within the scheduling domain. Missing for 10: detailed docs on workflow triggers, conditions and configuration depth; autonomy limited to meeting-communication scope rather than general agentic automations; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
